units.source_text: “对，对，早就想一见到您就马上告诉您的，他那长眉毛的事……”

en.t: Yes, yes, I had long wanted to tell you about that long eyebrow hair of his as soon as I saw you...

units.source_text: 夫人向名人投去诱导的目光，然后转脸对我说，

en.t: His wife cast an encouraging glance toward the Master, then turned her face to me and said,
It must have been the twelfth, when the weather had grown a little warmer.

units.source_text: 为了到热海去，得剃剃胡子，修修边幅，

en.t: Because he was going to Atami, he had to shave and make himself presentable,

units.source_text: 于是叫了个熟悉的理发师来，在太阳照到的廊道上刮脸。

en.t: so he called in a familiar barber and had his face shaved on a sunlit veranda.

units.source_text: 这时他忽然想起似的说，师傅，我的左眉上长了一根特别长的毛吧？

en.t: Then, as if suddenly remembering, he said, Master, there is one especially long hair growing in my left eyebrow, isn't there?

units.source_text: 师傅，据说长眉毛是长命相，

en.t: Master, they say a long eyebrow hair is a sign of long life,

units.source_text: 请你多加小心，别把它剃掉啰。

en.t: so please be very careful and do not shave it off.

units.source_text: 理发师‘哎’地应了声，歇了歇手，接着说，

en.t: The barber answered, Yes, paused his hands for a moment, and then said,
Yes, yes, sir, this is the one, isn't it?

units.source_text: 这是福气眉，您是长寿相啊！

en.t: This is a lucky eyebrow hair; you have the look of a long life!
I understand. I will be careful.

units.source_text: 内子还冲着我说：喏，浦上君给报纸写的观战记不是也提到这根眉毛吗？

en.t: My wife even said to me, Look, didn't Uragami mention that eyebrow hair too in the game report he wrote for the newspaper?

units.source_text: 浦上这个人观察得真细致啊。
连一根长眉毛他都注意到了，可我自己却没有发觉。

en.t: He noticed even a single long eyebrow hair, yet I myself had not realized it was there.

units.source_text: 他这样说了。看样子他很佩服您呢。”

en.t: That is what he said. It seems he admired you very much.
